rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for chatting, including chatting through a messaging app.

example.english: We chat whenever we have time.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 dak1 haan4 zau6 king1 gai2

rows.note: Use this shorter form for informal conversation when the context already makes the meaning clear.

example.jyutping: fong3 gung1 hau6 jat1 cai4 king1 haa5 laa1

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an informal conversation, including a quick chat.

example.english: We can have a chat over dinner later.
example.traditional: 我哋一陣食飯嗰陣傾偈。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jat1 zan6 sik6 faan6 go2 zan6 king1 gai2

rows.note: Use this when you specifically mean chatting online rather than talking face to face.

example.english: I chat online with my friends.
example.jyutping: ngo5 tung4 pang4 jau5 hai2 mong5 soeng6 king1 gai2

rows.note: Use this for an online chat room or the chat area of an online meeting.

example.english: This chat room is really lively.
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 liu4 tin1 sat1 hou2 jit6 naau6

rows.note: Use this when “the chat” means the comment or message area beside a live stream.

example.english: There were already lots of messages in the chat when the livestream started.
example.traditional: 直播一開始，留言區已經有好多留言。
example.jyutping: zik6 bo3 jat1 hoi1 ci2 lau4 jin4 keoi1 ji5 ging1 jau5 hou2 do1 lau4 jin4
